column2: ENGLISH

There comes a time when every child comes of age. A ritual is partaken where toys, child clothing and other things that marked one's childhood, are gathered and burned. This marks the end of childhood and beginning of adulthood.
It is time.

Your child has come of age. Their passing into adulthood has to be celebrated with a ritual. Gather their toys and other symbols of their childhood and burn them. Let your child put their childhood behind and become an adult.
They grow up so fast

The fire is lit and your toys, your little wooden sword and the clothes of your childhood go into it one by one while the whole court watches. The old words are said, the priest throws a pinch of salt on the flames, and when the smoke clears you are no longer a child.
The ritual has begun!
One of your skills will grow.

The time has come to prove your right to be counted among the grown. You will be left alone in the deep woods, with only your wits and your skill, for a full turn of the seasons. When you come out you will be a man or a woman of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]. If, of course, you survive...
There is no turning back now.

Your child has come of age to partake in the ritual of becoming an adult. They will be left in the deep woods, to fend for themselves and survive on their own, eventually coming out as a real adult. Say your farewells because not all children come back.
Come back to us, stay safe!
You have come home safe and sound! The Quickening has forged you anew. The childishness you had before is gone, and the innocent glow of a child is snuffed out by the wits of an adult.
Finally home!
While trying to steal food for yourself, you were caught red handed. Unable to escape, the men drag you to the floor and beat the living warp out of you.
Won't cry... it will pass... it will.
You curl up in a ball and hope they stop whipping your weak hide. You probably won't be in good shape after this.
Try to run away!
You will use your martial skill to try to outrun them. Failing will not be good.
Talk your way out!
You will try to talk your way out so you don't get your backside kicked, but you will get no food.
Your tummy aches, but you are in luck as you hear a commotion. Following the noise, you find travellers passing through. You see they carry supplies, food!
I am too weak, I will beg for food.
Success will depend on your diplomacy skill and failing will mean no food!
They still haven't discovered me, I will try to steal.
Success will depend on your intrigue skill and failing will mean no food, or worse.
They seem a bit lost and I know this area very well. I could guide them.
Success will depend on your stewardship skill and failing will mean no food.
Ha, they are weak, and I am not. I will rob them.
Success will depend on your martial skill and failing will mean no food or worse.
You hear someone moving around, almost sneaking. You hide and get ready, but luckily it is just a hunter moving cautiously through the woods. He seems lost.
He is a hunter, he could tell me more about hunting.
This depends on your diplomacy skill, and it can improve your martial skill.
I still have the upper hand. I could wait till he falls asleep and steal from him.
Success depends on your intrigue skill and can improve it, but failing will mean no food, or worse.
He is lost. I should help him and guide him.
This depends on your stewardship skill, and it can improve it.
I still have the upper hand. I will ambush him.
Success depends on your martial skill and can improve it, but failing will mean no food, or worse.

You hear whimpering somewhere close, barely audible but definitely there. Could it be a trap? You creep towards the sound and find a wounded child: another out on the Quickening, badly hurt and crying.
I have to save him!
You can try to save him with your learning. If you succeed your learning will grow, but you will have no food to eat.
You are already dead, I am taking your stuff!
This has a small chance to improve your intrigue.
He has supplies he won't be needing anymore
This has a small chance to improve your martial skill.
The child was not only badly wounded but starving too. He has no food on him, and if his wounds do not kill him, hunger will.
No food...
Meat is back on the menu boys!
You can hear your tummy grumbling, you are hungry. It is time to find food, through either gathering or hunting and feed yourself.
I will try to hunt
This depends on your martial skill.
I will try to forage
This depends on your learning.
I want my mommy to make me a stew, where is my mommy?
You start crying, rolling up on the ground. If you don't become too weak and die from starvation, the noise will probably attract a predator. You will die.
If you paid enough attention in those hunting lessons, you might be able to hunt by yourself. Now you must decide how to go about it. The day is running short and your stomach grumbles louder.
I will make a weapon.
A better chance to grow your martial skill, but a better chance to fail.
I will set traps. I can hold out till morning.
A fair chance to grow your martial skill and a low chance to fail.
I will hunt with whatever I have. A throwing stone will do if it has to.
A fair chance to grow your martial skill but a high chance to fail.
Those lessons about mushrooms and berries should come in handy now. Then again, did you really pay enough attention to know what is poisonous and what is not?
These mushrooms look edible. No odd colours.
A high chance to grow your learning but a high chance to fail.
Berries are a safer bet. I will gather those.
A fair chance to grow your learning and a lower chance to fail.
These berries look fine... I think.
A fair chance to grow your learning but a high chance to fail.
You have hurt yourself. Back home someone would tend to you and kiss it better, but out here only the trees and the beasts can hear you cry.
It's just a flesh wound!
Your martial skill is high enough to walk it off, and it may grow, though the wound might fester.
Herbal remedy, that can help me!
Your learning is high enough to heal yourself, and it may grow, though the wound might fester.
'Tis but a scratch.
Your martial skill is too low. A good chance it grows, but a high chance of being maimed.
I.. I can't... it hurts too much *Sniff*
You cry and hope someone will hear your whimpering, but no one comes. You die.
The wild beast you were hunting was in fact hunting you, and you have walked into its trap.
Please [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], let me survive!
I can only hope that the smell of piss and shit keeps me from being eaten tonight.

A grey-robed priest of Morr has come to speak your doom, as he does for every child of nine or ten. They say a child who has not been doomed walks under ill fortune. The rite takes but a night by the Garden of Morr and a small offering to the Lord of the Dead, and at its end the Doomsayer will tell you, in a single line, how you will die.
I am ready for Morr to speak my doom.
I don't think being doomed by the god of death sounds like a good idea.

A grey-robed priest of Morr has come to speak your doom, as he does for every child of nine or ten. Your horoscope was cast the night you were born, and the Doomsayer has read it. He closes his eyes in the Garden of Morr and the stars and the Raven God speak with one voice. At the end of the night he will tell you, in a single line, how you will die.
You will never know your doom, and the dread of it will gnaw at your health.

The priest of Morr has spoken [From.GetFirstName]'s doom, and it is the one the stars showed me on the night of [From.GetHerHis] birth. The Doomsayer looked at my horoscope a long while before he handed it back. The stars and the Lord of the Dead agree, and what is foretold twice is hard to escape.
What is written in the heavens is written.
When Morr's priest speaks the child's doom, it will follow the stars, and the child gains a little more of the foretold gift.
